keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Dário Essugo (Strasbourg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Ludovic Ajorque (Brest).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Strasbourg 0, Brest 1. Noah Edjouma (Brest) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Joseph Nonge.
Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Kenny Lala (Brest).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Brest. Luck Zogbé replaces Kenny Lala because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Lucas Høgsberg (Strasbourg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Strasbourg 0, Brest 1.
Second Half begins Strasbourg 0, Brest 1.
Lucas Tousart (Brest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Conrad Harder replaces Jacobo Ortega.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Pape Diop replaces Dário Essugo.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Diogo Sousa replaces Sebastian Nanasi.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Sam Amo-Ameyaw replaces Gessime Yassine.
Substitution, Brest. Giovani Versini replaces Pathé Mboup.
Substitution, Brest. Mama Baldé replaces Noah Edjouma.
Substitution, Brest. Mamady Diambou replaces Joseph Nonge.
Delay in match because of an injury Hugo Magnetti (Brest).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Omari Kellyman replaces Samir El Mourabet.
Delay in match because of an injury Gautier Lloris (Brest).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Diogo Sousa (Strasbourg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Martial Godo (Strasbourg) right footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Egil Selvik (Brest).
